Thermostat.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes a new Thermostat instance by assigning the current temperature, target temperature, and mode directly to instance attributes." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> current_temperature </REF>: numeric "The current temperature value to store."
        <REF> target_temperature </REF>: numeric "The target temperature value to store."
        <REF> mode </REF>: string "The operation mode to store, such as heat, cool, or off."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the current_temperature parameter to the instance attribute self.current_temperature. RESULT self.current_temperature]
            [COMMAND Assign the target_temperature parameter to the instance attribute self.target_temperature. RESULT self.target_temperature]
            [COMMAND Assign the mode parameter to the instance attribute self.mode. RESULT self.mode]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Thermostat.get_target_temperature:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Returns the current value of the target_temperature attribute." get_target_temperature]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: unknown "The current value stored in self.target_temperature."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read the current value of the self.target_temperature attribute and return it to the caller. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Thermostat.set_target_temperature:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Assigns the provided temperature value directly to the target_temperature instance attribute." set_target_temperature]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> temperature </REF>: any "The value to store; it is assigned without copying or conversion, so mutable values are aliased."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the value of the temperature parameter as-is to the target_temperature attribute on self. RESULT self.target_temperature]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Thermostat.get_mode:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Returns the current mode stored on the instance." get_mode]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: same type as self.mode "The current mode value."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Access the mode attribute on the current instance and return it as the method result. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Thermostat.set_mode:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Sets the object's mode attribute only if mode is exactly 'heat' or 'cool'; otherwise returns False." set_mode]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> mode </REF>: str "The mode value to validate and assign; accepted values are exactly 'heat' and 'cool'."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: bool or None "Returns False if mode is invalid; returns None after successfully assigning self.mode."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Evaluate whether mode is a member of the list ['heat', 'cool']. RESULT is_valid_mode]
            [COMMAND If is_valid_mode is True, assign mode to self.mode. RESULT self.mode]
            [COMMAND After the assignment, return None implicitly. RESULT None]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: mode is not 'heat' and mode is not 'cool' (equivalent to mode not in ['heat', 'cool']).]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return False immediately without modifying self.mode. RESULT False]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Thermostat.auto_set_mode:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Sets the HVAC mode to heat when the current temperature is strictly below the target temperature, and to cool otherwise." auto_set_mode]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Compare self.current_temperature and self.target_temperature using a strict less-than comparison, recording whether current temperature is below target. RESULT is_below_target]
            [COMMAND If is_below_target is true, assign 'heat' to self.mode. RESULT self.mode]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If is_below_target is false (current temperature is greater than or equal to target temperature)]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign 'cool' to self.mode. RESULT self.mode]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Thermostat.auto_check_conflict:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Checks whether the current thermostat mode matches the temperature condition, returning True when appropriate or calling auto_set_mode() and returning False otherwise." auto_check_conflict]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Thermostat instance containing current_temperature, target_temperature, mode, and auto_set_mode()."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return </REF>: boolean "True if the mode is compatible with the temperature; False after invoking auto_set_mode()."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check if self.current_temperature is strictly greater than self.target_temperature. RESULT temperature_above_target]
            [COMMAND In the above-target branch, check whether self.mode equals 'cool'. RESULT mode_is_cool]
            [COMMAND If mode_is_cool is true, return True immediately. RESULT return_true_for_cool]
            [COMMAND If mode_is_cool is false in the above-target branch, call self.auto_set_mode() and then return False. RESULT return_false_after_auto_set_mode_above]
            [COMMAND If temperature_above_target is false, meaning current temperature is less than or equal to target, check whether self.mode equals 'heat'. RESULT mode_is_heat]
            [COMMAND If mode_is_heat is true, return True immediately. RESULT return_true_for_heat]
            [COMMAND If mode_is_heat is false in the at-or-below-target branch, call self.auto_set_mode() and then return False. RESULT return_false_after_auto_set_mode_below]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
Thermostat.simulate_operation:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Automatically sets the operating mode, then simulates one-unit temperature adjustments until the current temperature equals the target temperature, returning the number of adjustment steps taken." simulate_operation]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> use_time </REF>: int "Number of simulated one-unit temperature adjustment steps performed to reach the target temperature."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call self.auto_set_mode() to determine and set the operating mode automatically. RESULT self.mode]
            [COMMAND Initialize use_time to 0. RESULT use_time]
            [COMMAND Branch on self.mode: when self.mode == 'heat', run the heating loop; otherwise run the cooling loop. RESULT use_time]
            [COMMAND Return use_time. RESULT use_time]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: self.mode == 'heat']
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Within the heat branch, while self.current_temperature is strictly less than self.target_temperature, increment self.current_temperature by 1. RESULT self.current_temperature]
            [COMMAND Within each iteration of the heat while loop, increment use_time by 1. RESULT use_time]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: self.mode != 'heat' (the else branch)]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Within the cooling branch, while self.current_temperature is strictly greater than self.target_temperature, decrement self.current_temperature by 1. RESULT self.current_temperature]
            [COMMAND Within each iteration of the cooling while loop, increment use_time by 1. RESULT use_time]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
